identifier_policy.id: Stable lowercase slug maintained by this project (the app's primary key).
identifier_policy.wikidata_qid: Filled only by `python -m app.ingest districts sync` from a live, verified Wikidata match. Null = not verified yet.
identifier_policy.census_2011_code: Census of India 2011 vintage. Left null: no authoritative complete code table could be verified for this project, and codes must never be invented.
identifier_policy.lgd_code: Local Government Directory (GoI) code. Left null for the same reason.
identifier_policy.division: Official Karnataka administrative revenue division (Bengaluru, Mysuru, Belagavi, or Kalaburagi).
identifier_policy.lat_lng: Official coordinates for the district headquarters administrative center.

districts.name: Bagalkote
districts.notes: District HQ: Bagalkote City. Major heritage circuits: Badami, Aihole, Pattadakal.

districts.name: Ballari
districts.notes: District HQ: Ballari City. Fort rock and industrial gateway.

districts.name: Belagavi
districts.notes: District HQ: Belagavi City. Northern transit hub bordering Maharashtra and Goa.

districts.name: Bengaluru Rural
districts.notes: District HQ: Doddaballapura. Features Ghati Subramanya and Shivagange.

districts.name: Bengaluru South
districts.notes: District HQ: Ramanagara (renamed from Ramanagara to Bengaluru South effective 2025-05-23).

districts.name: Bengaluru Urban
districts.notes: District HQ: Bengaluru. State capital and primary air/rail hub.

districts.name: Bidar
districts.notes: District HQ: Bidar City. Crown of Karnataka featuring Bahmani architecture and Bidriware.

districts.name: Chamarajanagara
districts.notes: District HQ: Chamarajanagara. Southern border district with Bandipur and B.R. Hills.

districts.name: Chikkaballapura
districts.notes: District HQ: Chikkaballapura City. Home of Nandi Hills and Bhoga Nandeeshwara.

districts.name: Chikkamagaluru
districts.notes: District HQ: Chikkamagaluru City. Coffee country and Western Ghats peak treks.

districts.name: Chitradurga
districts.notes: District HQ: Chitradurga City. Famous stone fortress and wind farms.

districts.name: Dakshina Kannada
districts.notes: District HQ: Mangaluru City. Coastal port and coastal culinary hub.

districts.name: Davanagere
districts.notes: District HQ: Davanagere City. Heart of Karnataka known for Benne Dosa and Harihar temple.

districts.name: Dharwad
districts.notes: District HQ: Dharwad City (twin city with Hubballi transit hub).

districts.name: Gadag
districts.notes: District HQ: Gadag-Betageri. Kalyana Chalukya architectural treasure at Lakkundi.

districts.name: Hassan
districts.notes: District HQ: Hassan City. Base for Belur, Halebidu, and Shravanabelagola.

districts.name: Haveri
districts.notes: District HQ: Haveri City. Known for Ranebennur wildlife and cardamom trade.

districts.name: Kalaburagi
districts.notes: District HQ: Kalaburagi City. Divisional capital with historic fort and Sufi heritage.

districts.name: Kodagu
districts.notes: District HQ: Madikeri Town. Scotland of India, misty coffee valleys and Cauvery origin.

districts.name: Kolar
districts.notes: District HQ: Kolar City. Land of gold mines (KGF) and Antara Gange rock caves.

districts.name: Koppal
districts.notes: District HQ: Koppal Town. Kinnal wood craft, Anegundi Kishkindha, and Itagi temple.

districts.name: Mandya
districts.notes: District HQ: Mandya City. Sugar city with Srirangapatna, Ranganathittu and Melkote.

districts.name: Mysuru
districts.notes: District HQ: Mysuru City. Royal heritage cultural capital.

districts.name: Raichur
districts.notes: District HQ: Raichur City. Doab region between Krishna and Tungabhadra rivers.

districts.name: Shivamogga
districts.notes: District HQ: Shivamogga City. Gateway to Malnad with Jog Falls and Agumbe rainforests.

districts.name: Tumakuru
districts.notes: District HQ: Tumakuru City. City of education and monolith hills (Madhugiri, DD Hills).

districts.name: Udupi
districts.notes: District HQ: Udupi City. Sri Krishna temple, pristine beaches, and culinary birthplace.

districts.name: Uttara Kannada
districts.notes: District HQ: Karwar City. Vast coastal rainforest district with Gokarna, Dandeli, and Murudeshwar.

districts.name: Vijayanagara
districts.notes: District HQ: Hosapete City (carved out in 2021). Heart of UNESCO Hampi monuments.

districts.name: Vijayapura
districts.notes: District HQ: Vijayapura City. Adil Shahi architectural capital home to Gol Gumbaz.

districts.name: Yadgir
districts.notes: District HQ: Yadgir Town. Historic hill fort on the Bhima river basin.
